description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for viewing detailed information about a task, including options to edit or delete the task. It interacts with a database to fetch tasks and manages UI elements such as AppBar, dialogs, and display of task details.

classes.name: TaskViewerScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget that displays detailed information of a task, allowing editing and deletion.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Fetches all tasks from the database and updates the UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the task viewer screen.
